items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: an immersion f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S is a monomorphism, and in particular is separated (source lines 1978-1982). The proof checks representability on an arbitrary representable Z -> Y: the base change Z x_Y X -> Z is an immersion of schemes, hence a monomorphism by the scheme statement, and therefore f is representable and a monomorphism of algebraic spaces; separatedness follows because monomorphisms are separated.
